events.command: ls -la; echo "---"; git ls-files; echo "--- grep ---"; grep -rn -e lookup -e pricing_cache -e CACHE_TTL_SECONDS . --exclude-dir=.git
for f in README.md inventory_reconciliation.py shipment_planner.py; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

git add pricing_cache.py && git commit -F - <<'EOF'
Extend pricing cache TTL to 1h, drop stale-snapshot fallback

Raise CACHE_TTL_SECONDS from 900 to 3600 so cached pricing entries stay
warm across a longer gap between feed refreshes.

Also removes lookup(), which returned the previous snapshot when the feed
arrived late. A one-hour TTL keeps entries live through a late feed, so
the fallback path is no longer needed. Nothing in this repo calls it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Two things worth flagging:

- **The "why" for deleting `lookup()` is my inference**, not something stated in the diff or the repo. I wrote the message on the reading that a longer TTL makes the stale-snapshot fallback redundant. If the deletion was actually unrelated (or accidental), tell me and I'll `git commit --amend`.
